issues.display_title: Issue #89: Fix Directory Ranking Algorithm and Pagination Limit on 360photographers.org
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation — Directory Unified Ranking & Grid Pagination

Status: Ready for review
Branch: fix/issue-117-directory-ranking
Related Issue: GoThruMedia/gothru-maps-backend-go#117

1. Context & Root Cause Analysis

On the main directory page (/ — "Top Rated 360° Photographers & Image Processing"), two major issues were observed:

  1. Low-profile provider appeared on the first page:
    • Incomplete or low-ranking providers (such as Zarar Chowdhury, whose backend score was only 8 with null avatar, null description, no tools, and 0 reviews) appeared on Page 1 under the default "Recommended" sort.
    • Legitimate high-ranking photographers and post-production specialists have scores between 72 and 74 (e.g., Werner Getzmann: 74, Alin Bugeag: 74, Tolga Yaman: 73).
  2. Uneven card count resulting in an empty grid slot on Page 1:
    • The directory rendered in a 3-column layout (xl:grid-cols-3).
    • Exactly 14 cards were displayed on Page 1 (4 full rows of 3 = 12 cards, followed by row 5 with only 2 cards), leaving the 3rd slot on the 5th row visibly empty.
  3. Paging discontinuity:
    • Deeper pages (Page 2, 3, etc.) never showed any image-processing providers regardless of their ranking.

Root Cause

The issue was not a defect in the backend ranking calculation. The backend correctly scored Zarar Chowdhury at 8 and Tolga Yaman at 73.

Instead, the defect originated from a client-side aggregation hack in the frontend:

  • src/app/page.tsx fetched 12 photographers via getPhotographersV2 (which defaulted to role=photographer_360), and separately fetched all image-processing users via getImageProcessingUsers().
  • src/components/directory-page.tsx forcibly concatenated all image-processing users to the end of Page 1: 
    // Old code in directory-page.tsx
const list = useMemo(() => {
  const merged = [
    ...photographers.map((p) => photographerToDirectoryItem(p, photographerTools)),
    ...(pageIndex === 0 && !filtered ? imageProcessingItems : []),
  ];
  return sortDirectoryItems(merged, sort);
}, ...);
  • Because there were only 2 image-processing users in the entire database (Tolga Yaman and Zarar Chowdhury), both were unconditionally appended to the end of Page 1.
  • This created $12 + 2 = 14$ items on Page 1, creating an empty slot in the 3-column grid and forcing a low-profile provider (Zarar Chowdhury, score 8) onto Page 1.
  • Furthermore, because pageIndex === 0 was required to append them, no image-processing specialists could ever appear on Page 2 or later.

2. Solution & Architecture

The backend endpoint GET /v2/photographers/users already supports multi-role queries natively:

  • When the query parameter role is omitted or empty (role=""), the backend queries both photographer_360 and image_processing roles.
  • It orders all matching providers uniformly by their directory score: ORDER BY effectiveRankingExpr DESC, photographers.rating_avg DESC, photographers.id DESC.
  • Keyset cursor pagination (cursor, size, hasMore, nextCursor) and total count work seamlessly across both roles.
  • Role-specific services and equipment (hardware gear for photographers, software tools for image processing) are resolved dynamically per record.

Key Changes Made

  1. Removed Client-Side Append Hack:
    • Removed the separate getImageProcessingUsers() call from src/app/page.tsx.
    • Removed imageProcessingItems and the manual merged array concatenation from src/components/directory-page.tsx.
  2. Unified API Role Querying:
    • Updated getPhotographersV2 in src/data/layer/photographers.ts so role is optional and does not default to ROLE_PHOTOGRAPHER_360. When role is omitted, the API queries all roles unified by directory ranking.
    • For the main directory (/), getPhotographersV2 is invoked with role: undefined (all roles).
    • For location-scoped views (countryId, cityId, continentId), role: ROLE_PHOTOGRAPHER_360 is retained because location counts (servedLocations) and on-site virtual tour capture specifically represent physical 360 photographers.
  3. Configured Grid Page Size to 15 Items:
    • Updated page size from 12 to 15 across server rendering (src/app/page.tsx) and client navigation actions (goToPage, handleSearch, resetFilters in src/components/directory-page.tsx).
    • 15 items perfectly fills 5 complete rows in the 3-column desktop layout ($5 \times 3 = 15$), eliminating empty slots.
  4. Role-Aware Directory Card Mapping:
    • Extended LocalPhotographer in src/lib/data.ts to include role, software, and services.
    • Updated adaptApiPhotographer in src/lib/adapt.ts to populate role and extract software items from equipment type 5.
    • Updated photographerToDirectoryItem in src/lib/directory-item.ts to detect role: "image_processing" and map appropriately:
      • Card href: /image-processing/[slug]
      • Role label: IMAGE PROCESSING
      • Tools: software applications (e.g., Adobe Photoshop, PTGui Pro)
      • Tags: post-production services (e.g., Image Stitching, Nadir Patching)
  5. Preserved Dedicated Surfaces:
    • /hire-image-processing continues to use getImageProcessingUsers() with explicit role: ROLE_IMAGE_PROCESSING.
    • Photographer sitemap generation (src/app/sitemap.ts) explicitly queries role: ROLE_PHOTOGRAPHER_360 to keep photographer URLs isolated from image-processing URLs.

3. Files Modified

File Changes
src/data/layer/photographers.ts Removed hardcoded default role = ROLE_PHOTOGRAPHER_360 from getPhotographersV2; only appends role to query when explicitly defined.
src/app/page.tsx Removed getImageProcessingUsers() call; requested size: 15; passed role: countryId ? ROLE_PHOTOGRAPHER_360 : undefined.
src/components/directory-page.tsx Removed manual imageProcessingItems concatenation and filtered hacks; updated resultCount to reflect total; updated pagination calls (goToPage, handleSearch, resetFilters) to size: 15 with conditional role filtering.
src/lib/data.ts Added optional role?: string, software?: string[], services?: string[] to Photographer.
src/lib/adapt.ts Mapped role, software (via getSoftware), and services in adaptApiPhotographer.
src/lib/directory-item.ts Handled both ROLE_PHOTOGRAPHER_360 and ROLE_IMAGE_PROCESSING in photographerToDirectoryItem.
src/app/sitemap.ts Explicitly passed role: ROLE_PHOTOGRAPHER_360 for photographer sitemap paging.
src/lib/directory-item.test.ts Added unit tests verifying directory item adaptation for both roles.

4. Verification

  1. Unit Tests:
    • Command: node --experimental-strip-types --test src/**/*.test.ts (via pnpm test)
    • Result: 19 tests passed, 0 failures.
  2. Type Check:
    • Command: pnpm tsc --noEmit
    • Result: Exit code 0 (no type errors).
  3. Linting:
    • Command: pnpm run lint
    • Result: 0 errors.
  4. Production Build:
    • Command: pnpm run build
    • Result: Successfully compiled and generated all static/dynamic routes.
  5. Expected Directory Output:
    • Zarar Chowdhury (score 8) no longer appears on Page 1.
    • Tolga Yaman (score 73) legitimately appears on Page 1 alongside photographers with comparable scores (72–74).
    • Page 1 contains exactly 15 items (5 full rows of 3), with no orphan slots.

Description:

Investigate and fix issues on the directory listing page (Top Rated 360° Photographers & Image Processing) where low-profile or incomplete providers (e.g., Zorar Chowdhury) appear on the first page under the default "Recommended" sort, and resolve an uneven item count resulting in an empty grid slot on page 1.
